input.summary: Remove three-year take-or-pay minimum commitment; pay only for Services used or ordered
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the three-year, USD 2,000,000 per year take-or-pay commitment because our playbook does not accept minimum purchase commitments without a reduction or exit right, and it contradicts Section 12.3's confirmation that we have made no minimum-volume commitment. If a commitment is commercially essential, we could consider one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer has no minimum purchase commitment. Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term.
